nom: Naturium Plant Ceramide Rich Moisture Cream

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report the cream can feel too heavy, greasy, and shiny, though a few say it balanced oily spots without extra shine.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including very dry and eczema-prone skin, most consistently report strong, lasting hydration and describe it as a holy grail for winter dryness.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report good balance (hydrated without excess oil), though one found it too thick and oily for her combination skin and advised against it for that skin type.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report gentle hydration with no irritation (including one used by a partner with rosacea), while others describe flare-ups, irritation, sore red spots, or an unexpected scent despite fragrance-free labeling.
segments.normal: The few reviewers identifying as normal skin report reliable, non-greasy hydration and say they repurchase it as a staple.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature or aging skin (in their 40s–60s) report plumping, smoother texture, and improved hydration, with one noting it did little for existing dark spots/melasma treated by other products in the line.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging skin report a plumping effect and smoother, more nourished skin; one long-term user noted fewer fine lines, though the brand's separate tranexamic acid product (not this cream) was said to do little for her dark spots.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers citing dry or dehydrated skin report significant, long-lasting hydration and relief from flaking, though a couple found it insufficiently moisturizing compared to other creams they'd used.
concerns.redness: Reviewers mention calming effects on 'angry' or irritated skin and one rosacea user found it soothing, but another reviewer reports it triggered a rosacea flare with bumpy, red cheeks.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema report the cream noticeably reduced flaking, itching, and redness within a couple of days of use, describing it as restorative for barrier-compromised skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation and uneven tone reports improved tone, texture, and smaller-looking pores; the brand's other targeted spot-treatment products were separately said to underperform.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report the cream did not cause breakouts and even helped clear skin, but multiple others report it caused breakouts, congestion, blackheads, or cystic-feeling bumps, particularly on oily-leaning or acne-prone skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers prone to oiliness mostly report the cream feels too rich, heavy, or greasy and increases shine or congestion, though a few with oily-combination skin say it did not add noticeable oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Rich, thick texture that melts in
Strong or unpleasant scent despite fragrance-free claim
Product separates or is hard to scoop from jar
Glass jar packaging risk and inconsistent batches

extraits.texte: Bought this based in reviews from other rosacea sufferers. It made my rosacea flare on my cheeks (super bumpy and red) and broke me out on my forehead and chin. Definitely patch test before slathering up your troubled skin!

extraits.titre: Simply just not for my skin
extraits.texte: I bought this about a month ago after my sister was using it and really liked it, previously using the nicinamide gel cream, which I really loved, and noticed a significant difference in the look of my skin. I tried it out because I was curious and thought it wouldn't hurt to try. ultimately after using it I can say that this product is simply not meant for my skin type item to have skin that's more on the oily side and I think it's just too rich and heavy of a cream for my skin. After using it, I noticed a not only visible difference in my skin, but also a texture difference with increased oil and Dole, like appearance. My skin became very congested on my cheeks and nose and for head anywhere where I normally produce oil. Generally not a good skin moment lots of under the skin bumps, blackheads and texture that I don't normally have. Also side note when I put it in my skin I should have known immediately it wasn't going to work as it felt like it was just sitting on top of my skin not absorbing. Overall not a bad product I think if you have dry skin this would work really well as the consistency is thicker and richer but if you have more oily skin I would skip.

extraits.titre: Free Sample - now my holy grail
extraits.texte: Naturium had included a free sample of this moisturizer in my last 3 orders. I was getting annoyed because I wasn't using it and it felt wasteful! The cream looked extremely thick and although I have dry skin, I am extremely acne prone so I typically steer clear of thick creams. A few weeks ago I ran out my moisturizer, I had these 3 samples and figured I would use it until I could order my normal moisturizer. A few nights and it wasn't breaking me out, so I figured I'd keep using it. After about week I noticed my skin was looking GORGEOUS and like a glazed donut, better than it's ever looked. I thought maybe it was the moisturizer because it was the only thing I had changed. I started using it on my neck and low & behold after about week the skin on my NECK even looked nice. I've now used up all 3 samples and ordered some. It's absolutely incredible and has done more for my skin than any other product. I have no idea what they put in this but it's a GOD SEND. If you have dry, sensitive skin but are still acne prone THIS IS THE MOISTURIZER OF YOUR DREAMS. Pairs amazing with a retinol, I've been using a very thin layer in the mornings and a normal amount at night!

I got this as a sample in my order and thought nothing of it. I've tried naturium moisturizers before and I liked them but I never loved them. I started using this as an eye cream at first because the sample size looks like an eye cream but one day I just decided to try it as a face moisturizer and immediately was impressed. I have eczema and very dry, sensitive, acne prone skin so it takes a lot for me to truly fall in love with a product but I love this. My skin has gotten even more dry because of the transition into winter which also causes my eczema to flare up A LOT - I'm talking flaky, itchy, red, irritated skin. This does tingle a little bit but it lasts only a second or two. It is so moisturizing so around mid day when my skin starts to flake and I need to reapply moisturizer, I checked my skin and didn't have any flakes. But the main thing that really impressed me was after only two days of using this morning and night, seeing my skin stopped me in my tracks. It looks so much more bouncy and has a healthier glow. My skin also looks much smoother and plump after using this. This is definitely going to be a product I restock on moving forward.

I received this as a sample and promptly ordered the largest dize I could! This rich mousturizer is perfect for my combination skin….really soothes dryness and is not yo heavy for oily spots. Feels like it balances my skin. And no fragrance so not irritating. I will never be eithout this!

I've been using this face moisturizer for probably about 2 years and I adore it. I use it every day after my serum and it's perfect for my skin that has always been dry, and is starting to age at age 40. My face does not look or feel 40!

I have very dry skin thats prone to post inflammatory hyperpigmentation and unevenness in tone. I've had a hard time finding something hydrating enough that doesn't leave me looking too shiny or feels like its just sitting on my skin. I've seen an improvement in my overall skin tone and texture since starting and the pores on my nose look smaller. I plan on restocking and seeing if the improvements continue with a second jar
